name: todo-bar
description: The task list's progress in a band above the prompt, read from the todo and task tools' own calls: no tool, no prompt, no tokens

visible.title: Show the band
visible.description: Show the progress band; /todos off and /todos on set this too

showNext.title: Show what comes next
showNext.description: A dim second row with the next one or two tasks

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band and /todos; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale
